paite: Akum sawm-le-khatna huai kha ani masapen in hichi ahong hi a, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Tura Kalh A Genkholhna
english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura in Jerusalem tungthu a, 'Nuam e! Namte kongkhak aseta, kei lam ah akihong, hihsiatgawp a a-om vek ziak in, ka tan hoih ding ahita,' "
english: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’

paite: huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, aw Tura, ka hon dou ahi, tuipi in tuihualte avoktouh bang mai in na tung a hong pai ding in nam tampi ka hon sawl ding.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

paite: Huchi in Tura kulhte ahihse ding ua, a-insangte achimsak ding ua, amah a kipan aleivui tengteng ka kheuhsiang ding a, suangpi keu lel in ka bawl ding hi.
english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

paite: Tui lai a len phoukeuna mun ahi mai ding, ke'n ka chita ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Huchi in namte a ding in gallak ahi mai ding.
english: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

paite: Huan atanu gam a omte namsau a hihlup ahih chiang un TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’

paite: "Ngai in, Tura tung ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, Kumpipate' kumpipa mallam a kipan in, sakolte toh sakol tungtuang mite, apawl leh mipi tampi mahmah ka hon pi dek ahi.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

paite: Gam ah namsau in na tanute athat ding; kulh abawl ding a, nang nanna ding in, nang douna ding in abawl ding, mual pawngte, nang douna kidalna abawlkhe ding hi.
english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

paite: Kulhbaang suksiatna bawl in, na kulh phelna ding, heipi in na insangte achimsak ding hi.
english: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.

paite: Asakol tam luat ding ziak in aleivuite un nang ahon tuam ding a, khopi akiphutvang nung a mite alut sek bang a, na kongpi a ahong lut hun chiang un, na kulhpi aling ding; sakol tungtuangte husa leh kidou kangtalai husa in.
english: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

paite: Sakol khechin in achilse ding, na kongzingte; na mite athat khin ding, namsau in; na hatna bangbang lei ah achim ding hi.
english: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

paite: Na gou thil gallak in ala ding ua; na van tengteng agubei ding uh; lei ah na kulhbaang achimsak ding ua, na inpi nuam ahihse vek ding uh, na suangte, na singte, na leivuite tui lai ah apai ding uh.
english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

paite: Ka khawlsak khin ding a, na lasak husate, na kaihging leng adai den ding hi.
english: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

paite: Suangpi keu lel in ka hon bawl ding a, len phoukeuna ding na hong hi ding hi, dinsak nawn na hi kei ding, kei TOUPA'N ka chita ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi hi.
english: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in Tura khua kiang ah hichi in achi, na sung a kithahnate a-om hun a, miliamte athum hun chiang in na puk ging in tuipi gei gamte aling kei ding ua hia?
english: “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

paite: Tuipi tung a heutute tengteng atutphah ua kipan apaisuk ding ua, apuan thupite uh akoih ding ua, apuansilh zephoihte uh asuahkhe ding ua; linna in akivan zawta ding ua, lei ah atu ding ua, alingling ding ua, lamdang ahon sa ding uh.
english: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

paite: Huchi in nang suunna la aphuak ding ua, na kiang ah, Khopi minthang, tuipi tung a hat, tuisiammi tengteng tenna sek, amah leh asung a tengte tengteng, mivialvakte'n ahon lauhlauh uh toh, na siatna thupi hi na tel e;
english: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”

paite: Na pukna ni in aling uh, tuikulh gamte; tuipi tuikulh alunglel ua, na man ni in, achi ding uh chi in.
english: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, khopi gam, kuamah luah louh khopi bang a ka hon bawl hun chiang in, tui thukpi ah ka hon tumsak ding a, tui thupi mahmah in ahon tum ding hi.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,

paite: Lei nuailam ah, nidang a segawpsa, khuk thuk a paisate kiang ah ka hon tengsak ding a, kuamah in ahon luahlouhna ding un leh mihingte lak a thupina na muh nawn hetlouhna ding in.
english: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

paite: Ka hon hihmang vengveng ding a, na om nawnta kei ding, mi'n hon zong mah le uh leng, ahon mu nawnta kei ding uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
